finding.why: Two distance checks replace diff.length() with a local function pointer fixed to JGeometry::TUtil<f32>::sqrt. There is no runtime choice of function. The introducing worker explicitly says this prevents MWCC from inlining the reciprocal-square-root refinement. The target direct call is real evidence of a missing call boundary; this redundant pointer is an unsupported way of forcing that boundary.

Final checkdiff confirms restoration of the 93.26398% baseline with no retained edit.
